value: Two-step verification is a requirement for all Shine Online Banking accounts; Dupaco cannot remove this security feature or the alerts that follow
quote: Two-step verification is a requirement for all Shine Online Banking accounts. We're unable to remove this security feature from your account as well as the alerts that follow.

attribute: how to receive two-step codes via text
value: Add mobile number in Shine Mobile via Profile > 'Two Step Notification' > 'Add contact'; or in Shine Online via Profile > Edit Profile > Actions > 'edit two-step'
quote: Select "Add contact", enter your number, and follow the prompts. In Shine Online: mouse over "Profile", select on "Edit Profile".

value: Choose 'Trust this device' on the login screen; not recommended for computers or devices you don't own
quote: Choose "Trust" this device" (on your login screen). Doing so secures your account with the most recent login code entered.

value: Enable face or fingerprint recognition or set up PIN Login via Device Security section of Profile; face/fingerprint requires device support
quote: Enable face or fingerprint recognition or setup PIN Login. Once you're logged in, you can configure either option from the Device Security section of your Profile.

attribute: transaction, balance and statement alert management
value: Log in to Shine Online Banking and go to the eNotifiers section to configure alerts
quote: login to Shine Online Banking and navigate to the eNotifiers section where you can configure which alerts you would like to receive.
